components.intent: Root assembly organizing the civic rotunda and its axial entrance portico.
Monument-scale cylindrical civic hall shell rising to the dome crown datum.
Coffered dome interior terminating in one central crown oculus opening.
Axial octastyle portico with eight frontal columns and two groups of four columns behind.
Triangular pediment and pitched gabled roof crowning the portico.

constraint_responses.rationale: The dome component explicitly reserves a coffered interior and a single central crown oculus within the full-height rotunda mass.
The portico component fixes the required eight-column first rank and two rear groups of four for later geometric articulation.
A dedicated pediment volume and component crown the colonnade and require triangular, pitched-roof articulation rather than a flat slab.

The rotunda uses a 44-cell vertical extent from ground to crown, approximating the 43.3-metre precedent datum; exact circular diameter and metric calibration remain schematic risks within the coarse planning grid.
The central hall and axial portico zones are directly joined by the undirected hall-portico connection.
The portico and daylit dome zones are directly joined by the undirected portico-dome connection.

proposal.label: Monumental Rotunda with Axial Octastyle Portico
proposal.rationale: The option establishes one rooted component hierarchy and three coarse volumes within the observed envelope. Its 100 planning cells at 10 square-cells per cell yield the minimum authorized 1000-square-cell footprint, while the 44-cell rotunda height preserves the precedent crown datum and the western portico aligns with the observed approach.
proposal.typology_hypothesis: A monument-scale central civic rotunda aligned to the observed western approach and fronted by an octastyle, pedimented portico, with a coffered daylit dome and single crown oculus.

constraints.statement: The rotunda dome is coffered on its interior and pierced by one central oculus opening at the crown.
The portico colonnade is octastyle: eight columns in the first rank with two groups of four columns behind them.
The portico must be crowned by a triangular pediment carrying a pitched (gabled) roof form; a flat slab roof does not satisfy the adopted precedent.

The rotunda interior diameter and the height to the oculus are each 43.3 metres; the massing must be sized to this monument-scale precedent within the authorized site envelope, filling the declared footprint rather than placing a token model on it.

payload.instructions: Author one schematic option from only the supplied current records. Create the existing DesignComponent tree and its coarse massing volumes in the same proposal. Every volume must have exactly one component owner. Preserve project evidence references and return only the required output object; do not select, persist, execute, or claim validation.

component_geometry_invariants: components form exactly one rooted acyclic tree
every volume id exists and is owned by exactly one component
component and volume source refs are present in evidence_refs
proposal authority fields equal proposal_fixed_values exactly

item_exact_fields.unresolved_child_roles: array of local-id strings; empty allowed
item_exact_fields.volume_ids: array of local-id strings; empty allowed

exact_fields.maximum: exactly [integer x, integer y, integer z]
exact_fields.minimum: exactly [integer x, integer y, integer z]

assumptions.statement: The test program remains an evidence-bound project hypothesis.

reference_contract.nested_source_rule: every nested source_ref must also appear in proposal.evidence_refs

required_invariants: program_scenario_ref names a current program scenario
footprint_range_ref names a compatible current footprint range
footprint area equals len(footprint_cells) multiplied by grid_basis.horizontal_area_per_cell
footprint area is within the cited footprint range and uses the same area_unit
every footprint cell x/z lies inside the observed site envelope
every level spans inclusive y from base_y through base_y + height - 1 inside the site envelope
every volume bound lies inside the site envelope and names only current level_ids
for each volume include every inclusive [x,z] pair from bounds.minimum through bounds.maximum in footprint_cells
each volume projection contains at most 4096 inclusive x/z cells
each named level is vertically contained by its volume bounds
every current function_ref appears in exactly one zone and no other program_node_ref is used
every zone names only declared level_ids and volume_ids
each connection joins zones containing its relationship source and target nodes and matches relationship directed exactly
every required response ref is covered by a constraint_response or a matching connection relationship_ref
